# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

Meet the Fitzgerald family: Mom, dad, and 6 kids. Life with chronic conditions is not simple, but
with CVS Health by their side, managing chronic conditions becomes a little… simpler.

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable

    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.

    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.

    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.

    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

eligible expenses and commonly used tax forms — all in one place.

  Register or sign in and fill your specialty prescriptions for complex therapies
* [ Infusion Pharmacy ][29]
  
  Register or sign in and manage your infusion therapies

  Manage your medications for rare disease
* [ divvyDOSE ][31]
  
  Enroll to get medications pre-sorted by day and time and delivered to your home

  Manage your medications for mental health and complex conditions

  Track your home delivery and specialty order

# Cultivating confidence from the inside out
#  

At Damn Girl! Aesthetics and Wellness, we believe confidence, health, and longevity are deeply
connected. Our personalized aesthetic and wellness care is designed to enhance natural beauty,
support well-being, and deliver safe, refined, long-term results—so you can feel confident,
empowered, and more like yourself.

## Personalized Care. Natural Results. 

## Long-Term Confidence.

Here at Damn Girl! Aesthetics and Wellness, we know that when you feel and look good, there’s
nothing stopping you!


Nestled in the heart of San Antonio, Texas, our boutique MedSpa creates personalized aesthetic and
wellness treatments to make you feel and look revitalized, radiant and confident. As a small
practice, we take pride in providing all of our patients with undivided attention and expertise in a
safe, relaxing and comfortable environment.


Your treatment plan should be as individual as you are. From the moment you walk through our doors,
we take the time to understand your goals, your concerns, and the bigger picture of your health and
confidence.


Together, we create a personalized plan designed to support your skin, body, and wellness from the
inside out. Our goal is never to change who you are. It’s to help you look refreshed, feel
empowered, and age with confidence and strength.


[image of Kelly Powers with Damn Girl! aesthetics and wellness standing in her office ]

## A different aesthetics and wellness

## Experience

At Damn Girl! Aesthetics and Wellness, we’re redefining non-surgical care by combining advanced
aesthetic treatments with whole-person wellness support. We focus on education, safety,
natural-looking outcomes, and meaningful relationships—because we want to be more than a place you
visit for a treatment.

We want to be your trusted partner in feeling confident, supported, and well for years to come.

nothing stopping you!

safe, relaxing and comfortable environment.

confidence.

inside out. Our goal is never to change who you are. It’s to help you look refreshed, feel
empowered, and age with confidence and strength.

visit for a treatment.

ABOUT

#### Total Solution for Private Label
#### Turnkey
#### Skincare Patches

Short lead times, combined with full customization of product, formulation, and packaging, make
DERMATECH a leading partner for brands seeking an acne patch manufacturer, pimple patch
manufacturer, or hydrocolloid/hydrogel manufacturer in Korea.

[DERMATECH ACNE PATCH 3D ANIMATION.gif]
[DERMATECH MICRONEEDELE 3D ANIMATION - med res.gif]

VALUE

Quality, speed, safety,  reliability - the best value. Maximize your margins & consumer
satisfaction. 

CUSTOM

We integrate a brands signature formulation or concept ingredients into our patches, or develop a
unique formulation for you.

STABILITY

DERMATECH patches are formulated to pass rigorous stability testing, and have a track record of
success in global retail distribution.

EXPORT SUPPORT

We facilitate export / import clearance & global logistics to ensure your products arrive in your
market quickly and safely.

#### MATERIALS & TECHNOLOGIES

SKINCARE PATCHES BY TYPE

##### Invisible Patches

The thinnest, most durable, and most stable patches. Can be formulated to treat a wide variety of
cosmetics issues: acne patch, pimple patch, brightening patch...

PRODUCTS

##### Hydrocolloid Patches

The flexible material works by absorbing fluid from a wound while keeping the skin around it moist,
which is key for speeding up the healing process. These patches have proven highly effective against
acne blemishes and pimples. They work by supporting the skins natural ability to cure from within,
while blocking harmful impurities.

##### Invisible Hydrocolloid Patches

The sticky, gel-like material that allows hydrocolloid to work can be quite bulky. DERMATECH offers
patches that combine the function of hydrocolloid with the lowest profile on the market. These
patches are almost invisible day or night, provide perfect adhesion, and work well under makeup. 

##### Formulated Hydrocolloid Patches

Upgrade the already-excellent function of hydrocolloid by adding active skincare ingredients.
Whether you are seeking to integrate your brands signature formulation into a patch, or prefer our
lab to develop a proprietary formula for you, these patches offer more function and key selling
points.

##### Spot Treatment Patches

Patches formulated for spot treatment generally contain ingredients to fight acne blemishes, and
pimples, or dark spots / hyper pigmentation. Available in a variety of diameters to fit your
specifications.

##### Line Treatment Patches

Smile lines, forehead lines, and other wrinkles can be treated with elongated patched that are
manufactured to adhere to these tricky spots long enough to deliver your wrinkle fighting
ingredients and smooth fine lines.

##### Wide-Coverage Hydrocolloid Patches

When a spot won't do it, a wide-coverage patch, available in square, rectangular, or custom shapes
for the facial area, will treat clusters trouble spots with one large specification patch.

##### Under-Eye Patches

Hydrocolloid and hydrogel patches are designed to adhere to the under-eye area, provide delivery of
lifting, brightening, and anti-aging formulations, while also smoothing and calming delicate skin.

##### Microneedle Patches

Our most high-tech patches, are also the most high-tech in the world. We combine all the benefits of
a hydrocolloid patch with TDDS Transdermal Drug Delivery System technology. These patches deliver
your formulation directly into the trouble area. The microneedles slowly release your formulation,
while dissolving in the skin. Once fully dissolved the outer layer of hydrocolloid remains in place
ensuring protection and advanced healing.

##### FDA OTC & Class 1 Medical Device

OTC acne patches contain an FDA controlled level of drugs (active ingredients), produced in
compliance with FDA regulation for sale in the US market. Our hydrocolloid is also FDA Class 1
Medical Device & EU C.E. Certified as an occlusive wound dressing. Regulatory class availability
varies by base material and several other factors. 

##### Custom Shape & Full Color Print Patches

Achieve a unique, differentiated, or fun look without loss of function, durability, and safety. 
DERMATECH offers the widest range of customizations in the patch industry -- shape, size, color, and
full-color digital printing.

#### SKINCARE REVOLUTION

55+

Global Markets

200+

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

## What our customers are saying
* ### Knowing where to look
  
  "A competitor quietly sunsetted a feature — no announcement, no changelog, no blog post. The only
  trace was a small edit buried in their developer docs. ForesightIQ flagged it."
  
  [Mitch Eger]
  Mitch EgerProduct Marketing Manager, Polygon Labs
* ### Signals incumbent tools miss
  
  "Crayon missed an entire Square ads campaign. ForesightIQ caught it — screenshots and all — and
  it's directly shaped how our Brand team positioned our next campaign."
  
  [Min Chi]
  Min ChiSenior Manager, Insights, Public SaaS Company
* ### Future focused insights
  
  "ForesightIQ isn't a rearview mirror. It shows me where companies are headed next."
  
  [Marco Burgarello]
  Marco BurgarelloGTM Leader, Nextiva

Sources

## Beyond the usual sources

We monitor the hidden sources everyone misses plus integrate custom sources specific to your
industry.

FAQ

## You ask. We answer.

Have more questions? See our full [FAQ][57] or [Contact us][58].

[GET STARTED][59]

### Can I get Accutane prescribed online?

Yes. Honeydew's licensed dermatologists prescribe Accutane (isotretinoin) entirely online — no
in-person office visits required. You complete a short questionnaire, share photos of your skin, and
a board-certified dermatologist reviews your case. If Accutane is appropriate, your prescription is
sent directly to a pharmacy or delivered to your door. We also manage all iPLEDGE requirements,
monthly check-ins, and lab monitoring on your behalf.

### How is getting Accutane online through Honeydew different from going to a dermatologist's
### office?

With a traditional dermatologist, you may wait weeks or months for an appointment, visit in person
every month for refills, and navigate iPLEDGE on your own. With Honeydew, everything is handled
online, from your first consultation to monthly monitoring and prescription refills. You get the
same licensed dermatologist oversight, just without the waiting room.

### What acne treatments can I get online through Honeydew?

Honeydew's dermatology providers prescribe the full range of FDA-approved acne treatments online,
including Accutane (isotretinoin), low-dose Accutane, spironolactone, tretinoin, doxycycline,
clindamycin, and custom compounded formulas. Whether you're dealing with mild breakouts, hormonal
acne, cystic acne, or treatment-resistant acne, your provider builds a personalized treatment plan
and adjusts it over time as your skin responds.

### Is online acne treatment as effective as seeing a dermatologist in person?

Yes, the treatments are identical. Honeydew providers are board-certified dermatologists and
licensed nurse practitioners who prescribe the same FDA-approved medications you'd receive in a
traditional office. The difference is convenience: you get expert acne care without the wait,
without commuting, and with ongoing support 7 days a week.

### Do I need insurance to see an online dermatologist through Honeydew?

No insurance is required to get started. Honeydew charges a flat monthly, 4-month or annual
membership fee, and we'll run your prescriptions through your insurance to minimize medication
costs, in some cases bringing your Accutane or other prescriptions to $0. If you don't have
insurance, generic pricing is available starting as low as $30/box. The membership fee is also
HSA/FSA eligible.

### What skin conditions does Honeydew treat online?

Honeydew's online dermatology providers treat acne (including cystic, hormonal, and
treatment-resistant acne), eczema, psoriasis, and rosacea. 

For acne specifically, we offer the full spectrum of treatments, from topical prescriptions to oral
medications like Accutane, all managed 100% online with ongoing dermatologist oversight.

### What is online dermatology and how does it work?

Online dermatology, also called teledermatology, lets you consult with a licensed dermatologist and
receive prescription treatment through a secure digital platform, without visiting a clinic. At
Honeydew, you submit a brief health history and skin photos, and a board-certified dermatologist
reviews your case and prescribes the right treatment. Medications are sent to your pharmacy or
shipped directly to you.

FAQ

## You ask. We answer.

Have more questions? See our full [FAQ][57] or [Contact us][58].

[GET STARTED][59]

### Can I get Accutane prescribed online?

Yes. Honeydew's licensed dermatologists prescribe Accutane (isotretinoin) entirely online — no
in-person office visits required. You complete a short questionnaire, share photos of your skin, and
a board-certified dermatologist reviews your case. If Accutane is appropriate, your prescription is
sent directly to a pharmacy or delivered to your door. We also manage all iPLEDGE requirements,
monthly check-ins, and lab monitoring on your behalf.

### How is getting Accutane online through Honeydew different from going to a dermatologist's
### office?

With a traditional dermatologist, you may wait weeks or months for an appointment, visit in person
every month for refills, and navigate iPLEDGE on your own. With Honeydew, everything is handled
online, from your first consultation to monthly monitoring and prescription refills. You get the
same licensed dermatologist oversight, just without the waiting room.

### What acne treatments can I get online through Honeydew?

Honeydew's dermatology providers prescribe the full range of FDA-approved acne treatments online,
including Accutane (isotretinoin), low-dose Accutane, spironolactone, tretinoin, doxycycline,
clindamycin, and custom compounded formulas. Whether you're dealing with mild breakouts, hormonal
acne, cystic acne, or treatment-resistant acne, your provider builds a personalized treatment plan
and adjusts it over time as your skin responds.

### Is online acne treatment as effective as seeing a dermatologist in person?

Yes, the treatments are identical. Honeydew providers are board-certified dermatologists and
licensed nurse practitioners who prescribe the same FDA-approved medications you'd receive in a
traditional office. The difference is convenience: you get expert acne care without the wait,
without commuting, and with ongoing support 7 days a week.

### Do I need insurance to see an online dermatologist through Honeydew?

No insurance is required to get started. Honeydew charges a flat monthly, 4-month or annual
membership fee, and we'll run your prescriptions through your insurance to minimize medication
costs, in some cases bringing your Accutane or other prescriptions to $0. If you don't have
insurance, generic pricing is available starting as low as $30/box. The membership fee is also
HSA/FSA eligible.

### What skin conditions does Honeydew treat online?

Honeydew's online dermatology providers treat acne (including cystic, hormonal, and
treatment-resistant acne), eczema, psoriasis, and rosacea. 

For acne specifically, we offer the full spectrum of treatments, from topical prescriptions to oral
medications like Accutane, all managed 100% online with ongoing dermatologist oversight.

### What is online dermatology and how does it work?

Online dermatology, also called teledermatology, lets you consult with a licensed dermatologist and
receive prescription treatment through a secure digital platform, without visiting a clinic. At
Honeydew, you submit a brief health history and skin photos, and a board-certified dermatologist
reviews your case and prescribes the right treatment. Medications are sent to your pharmacy or
shipped directly to you.

[logo][logo]
A healthy, glowing skin begins here.

## Innovative Dermatological, Surgical, & Aesthetic Treatments

Welcome to Oak Dermatology, where over 150 years of combined expertise in medical, surgical, and
aesthetic dermatology ensure exceptional care. Our cutting-edge techniques and technologies serve
Naperville, Itasca, Joliet, and the greater Chicago area, offering personalized and rejuvenating
treatments always in the forefront of our field.

Learn more about us

skin cancer, warts, and much more.

## Plastic Surgery

how you look. Your face tells a unique story and reflects your individuality to the world. We don't
aim to make you look like someone else — we simply want to help you enhance your natural beauty and
outsmart the effects of time.

## Facelift

Revitalize your appearance with our facelift procedure, designed to lift and tighten sagging skin,
delivering a youthful, refreshed look that enhances your natural beauty.

Transform your appearance with Breast Enhancement surgery at Oak Dermatology. This procedure
reshapes and rejuvenates your breasts by tightening surrounding tissue and removing excess skin.
Achieve firmer, fuller, and younger-looking breasts with the expertise of our skilled surgeons.
Trust us to help you look and feel your best with natural, stunning results tailored to your unique

Achieve a refreshed and confident appearance with minimal downtime. Trust Oak Dermatology for
stunning, natural-looking results tailored to your unique needs.

Revitalize your appearance with Ear Repair at Oak Dermatology. Our skilled plastic surgeons

altering the size of your ears or repairing torn earlobes, our expert team ensures natural-looking
results. Achieve a balanced and harmonious look with minimal downtime. Trust Oak Dermatology for
exceptional care and personalized ear repair solutions tailored to your needs.

look and enhance your confidence. Trust Oak Dermatology for outstanding care and beautiful outcomes.

renewed sense of confidence with minimal downtime. Trust Oak Dermatology for exceptional care and
transformative outcomes.

uses advanced laser technology to target and liquefy fat cells, which are then transferred to
desired areas for added volume and contour. Achieve a fuller, more youthful appearance with minimal
downtime. Our skilled team ensures natural, long-lasting results. Trust Oak Dermatology for
personalized care and stunning enhancements tailored to your unique needs.

Cooperation [[News] News ][207] [ProBio CDMO Awards] Awards * [news-image] * [news] * [news-image] [ProBio | GenScript ProBio - Global Biologics CDMO] ## About ProBio # ProBio – Biologics CDMO ProBio, a subsidiary of GenScript Biotech Corporation, is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) that accelerates the discovery, development, and commercialization of biologics and advanced therapies. Combining innovative discovery platforms with integrated development and GMP manufacturing capabilities, ProBio provides end-to-end solutions across antibodies, recombinant proteins, plasmid DNA, mRNA, viral vectors, and in vivo CAR-T therapies. From target discovery and lead optimization through process development, clinical supply, and commercial manufacturing, ProBio helps partners advance complex programs with speed, quality, and confidence. Its scalable technology platforms, global manufacturing network, and deep scientific expertise enable efficient progression from concept to clinic and beyond. Through a collaborative, risk-sharing approach, ProBio also offers flexible licensing and co-development opportunities, helping biotech and pharmaceutical companies reduce development risk, accelerate timelines, and bring innovative therapies to patients faster. ### Contact us For more information about our company and services, please feel free to reach out to our team. Методика Pro-Acne — системный подход с доказанной эффективностью.
* Точная диагностика типа и степени акне.
* Подробный сбор информации и анамнеза.

  ограничивать все потенциальные провокаторы акне.

* способы лечения акне с применением косметических машин и без них.

  пигментации, поствоспалительной эритемы, шрамов и коррекции возрастных изменений
* В-третьих, молва о хорошем сервисе расходится быстро, и люди готовы ездить даже издалека

онлайн-сессии и даю обратную связь.

*Отзыв Эвелины, косметолога-эстетиста. *
*﻿Прошла обучение в школе PRO-ACNE в 2022 году *
Я Вероника Асташонок, основатель и руководитель клиники по лечению акне в Нью-Йорке AcneClinicNYC

На практике выстроила поминутные протоколы кабинетных процедур, протоколы домашних режимов и в целом
систему ведения клиентов с акне. Сегодня мы единственные, кто может за 3-4 месяца вылечить самую
тяжелую форму акне без системных ретиноидов и помочь человеку сохранить ремиссию.

Я практик, а не инфобизнесмен. Ежедневно собственноручно работаю с клиентами, провожу консультации,
обучаю команду и ввожу в наш инструментарий новые методы. Именно поэтому на курсе лично веду
онлайн-сессии и даю обратную связь.

## Your Premier Bulk Supplier & Wholesale Distributor

SDA is the East Coast alternative to McLane, UNFI, and C&S for national‑brand health, beauty, OTC,
and household consumables.

We provide the massive brand catalog of a mega-distributor, but with the speed, flexibility, and
dedicated service that independent retailers and regional chains actually need to thrive. Welcome to
Supermarket Distributors of America (SDA), your trusted B2B partner for wholesale goods. We have
been in the business for decades, acting as a dedicated bulk supplier and premier bulk wholesaler
for Institutions, superstores, pharmacies, and convenience stores.
* **Comprehensive Inventory:** We are bulk suppliers of practically anything your retail shelves
  require.
* **Large-Volume Orders:** Case, pallet, and truckload bulk ordering options.
* **Factory-Fresh:** Current-dated inventory with high in-stock ratios to reduce out-of-stocks.
* **Reliable Freight:** We ensure your bulk orders are picked, packed, and shipped efficiently.

### Who we serve

Our customer base includes a wide range of retail and institutional buyers:
* Institutions & wholesalers
* College & school bookstores
* Airline hospitality and lounge
* Country Clubs & sports club
* Dollar & discount stores
* Pharmacies & drug stores
* Convenience stores
* Hotels & hospitality
* Correctional Facilities
* Government Contracts
* Non-profits
* Superstores

## Featured brands & product lines

We stock many of the brands your customers recognize and request, plus value alternatives to support
your price points.

[Bic][139] [Body Fortress][140] [CeraVe][141] [Chapstick][142] [Cold-Eeze][143] [Curad][144] [De La
Cruz][145] [Dove][146] [Dramamine][147] [Emergen-C][148] [Galderma][149] [GilletteLabs][150] [Head
Penn][151] [Kleenex][152] [Metamucil][153] [Midol][154] [Old Spice][155] [Pepto-Bismol][156]
[Pfizer][157] [Playtex][158] [Purell][159] [Ricola][160] [Tena][161] [Vaporub][162] [Vicks][163]
[Zicam][164]

## Frequently asked questions

A quick overview of who we are, who we serve, and how to get started with a wholesale account.

What is Supermarket Distributors of America? +

Supermarket Distributors of America is a New York-based major wholesale supplier and distributor of
health, beauty, personal care, OTC, baby care, household and cleaning products serving wholesalers,
large-volume institutional buyers, pharmacies, dollar and discount stores, convenience stores,
corner markets and superstores across the United States and North America.

Does SDA function as a supplier or a distributor? +

SDA operates as both. We act as a **wholesale supplier** by sourcing factory-fresh inventory
directly from manufacturers, and we serve as a **distributor** by managing the logistics of
delivering that bulk stock to supermarkets, pharmacies, and discount stores.

What types of products does Supermarket Distributors of America supply? +

We supply a wide range of national and regional brands across health, beauty, personal care, OTC
medicines, baby care, household and cleaning supplies, paper goods, oral care, feminine care, and
more.

Who can buy from SDA? +

SDA is a business-to-business wholesale distributor. Customers typically include superstores,
schools, independent grocers, drug stores, dollar and discount stores, convenience stores,
wholesalers, hotels and institutional buyers. We do not sell directly to consumers.

What areas do you serve? +

Supermarket Distributors of America is based in New York and supplies customers throughout New York
and across the United States and North America through its wholesale distribution network.

How do I open a wholesale account with Supermarket Distributors of America? +

To open a wholesale account with Supermarket Distributors of America, merchants and vendors can
contact our sales team using the contact form or call our office. A representative will review your
business information, discuss your needs, determine applicable volume discounts and help you
complete any required account setup documentation.

Do you have minimum order requirements? +

Yes, minimum order requirements may apply and can vary by category, program and shipping
destination. Initial orders starting at $1000. Please contact our sales team to review current
minimums and wholesale order terms for your business.

Which types of stores and customers does Supermarket Distributors of America specialize in? +

We specialize in supplying superstores, independents, neighborhood grocery stores, discount and
dollar stores, pharmacies, convenience stores, government contractors and large-volume orders for
institutional buyers that need reliable wholesale health, beauty, personal care, OTC, and household
products.

How do I get pricing or open a wholesale account? +

To request pricing or open a wholesale account, retailers can use our [contact form][165] on the SDA
website or call **(631) 273-3900**. A sales representative will review your business information,
product availability, pricing and volume discounts, delivery details, service area and categories of
interest to help you get started.

## Your Premier Bulk Supplier & Wholesale Distributor

SDA is the East Coast alternative to McLane, UNFI, and C&S for national‑brand health, beauty, OTC,
and household consumables.

We provide the massive brand catalog of a mega-distributor, but with the speed, flexibility, and
dedicated service that independent retailers and regional chains actually need to thrive. Welcome to
Supermarket Distributors of America (SDA), your trusted B2B partner for wholesale goods. We have
been in the business for decades, acting as a dedicated bulk supplier and premier bulk wholesaler
for Institutions, superstores, pharmacies, and convenience stores.
* **Comprehensive Inventory:** We are bulk suppliers of practically anything your retail shelves
  require.
* **Large-Volume Orders:** Case, pallet, and truckload bulk ordering options.
* **Factory-Fresh:** Current-dated inventory with high in-stock ratios to reduce out-of-stocks.
* **Reliable Freight:** We ensure your bulk orders are picked, packed, and shipped efficiently.

### Who we serve

Our customer base includes a wide range of retail and institutional buyers:
* Institutions & wholesalers
* College & school bookstores
* Airline hospitality and lounge
* Country Clubs & sports club
* Dollar & discount stores
* Pharmacies & drug stores
* Convenience stores
* Hotels & hospitality
* Correctional Facilities
* Government Contracts
* Non-profits
* Superstores

## Featured brands & product lines

your price points.

## Frequently asked questions

A quick overview of who we are, who we serve, and how to get started with a wholesale account.

What is Supermarket Distributors of America? +

Supermarket Distributors of America is a New York-based major wholesale supplier and distributor of
health, beauty, personal care, OTC, baby care, household and cleaning products serving wholesalers,
large-volume institutional buyers, pharmacies, dollar and discount stores, convenience stores,
corner markets and superstores across the United States and North America.

Does SDA function as a supplier or a distributor? +

SDA operates as both. We act as a **wholesale supplier** by sourcing factory-fresh inventory
directly from manufacturers, and we serve as a **distributor** by managing the logistics of
delivering that bulk stock to supermarkets, pharmacies, and discount stores.

What types of products does Supermarket Distributors of America supply? +

We supply a wide range of national and regional brands across health, beauty, personal care, OTC
medicines, baby care, household and cleaning supplies, paper goods, oral care, feminine care, and
more.

Who can buy from SDA? +

SDA is a business-to-business wholesale distributor. Customers typically include superstores,
schools, independent grocers, drug stores, dollar and discount stores, convenience stores,
wholesalers, hotels and institutional buyers. We do not sell directly to consumers.

What areas do you serve? +

Supermarket Distributors of America is based in New York and supplies customers throughout New York
and across the United States and North America through its wholesale distribution network.

How do I open a wholesale account with Supermarket Distributors of America? +

To open a wholesale account with Supermarket Distributors of America, merchants and vendors can
contact our sales team using the contact form or call our office. A representative will review your
business information, discuss your needs, determine applicable volume discounts and help you
complete any required account setup documentation.

Do you have minimum order requirements? +

Yes, minimum order requirements may apply and can vary by category, program and shipping
destination. Initial orders starting at $1000. Please contact our sales team to review current
minimums and wholesale order terms for your business.

Which types of stores and customers does Supermarket Distributors of America specialize in? +

We specialize in supplying superstores, independents, neighborhood grocery stores, discount and
dollar stores, pharmacies, convenience stores, government contractors and large-volume orders for
institutional buyers that need reliable wholesale health, beauty, personal care, OTC, and household
products.

How do I get pricing or open a wholesale account? +

To request pricing or open a wholesale account, retailers can use our [contact form][165] on the SDA
website or call **(631) 273-3900**. A sales representative will review your business information,
product availability, pricing and volume discounts, delivery details, service area and categories of
interest to help you get started.

#### Supermarket Distributors of America

**Supermarket Distributors of America** is a B2B wholesale distributor of **health, beauty, personal
care, OTC, baby care, household, and cleaning products,** supplying **retailers, wholesalers,
merchants, and institutional buyers across North America.**

# The Future of Dermatology is Now*

A Digital Health Platform Focused on Increasing Access to Medications, Improving Adherence, and
Providing Real World Solutions to Alleviate Healthcare Burdens for Both Patients and Physicians
* [Physician Search][28]
* [Physician Sign Up][29]
* No More Prior Authorizations
* Transparent Affordable Pricing
* Increasing Access to Medications
* Increasing Patient Adherence and Patient Satisfaction
* Decreasing The Financial Burden On The Healthcare System

## Why Choose Skin Medicinals?

### Skin Medicinals was created to provide patients with access to science-based, oral and topical
### medications along with customized acne and anti-aging compounds at affordable prices.

We strive to provide high quality medications for every patient utilizing the expertise of their
physicians.

#### Patient Benefits
* Fraction of the traditional price of most medications
* Decrease potential for long-term increases to insurance premiums
* Shipped directly to your home

#### Dermatologist Benefits
* No more prior authorizations
* Decreased financial burdens on the healthcare system
* Skin Medicinals donates a portion of proceeds to non-profits supporting dermatology and its
  patients

[ Watch Video ][30]

## How much should a prescription cost? Less than you think.

### With most medications, it’s important to note that your Copay does NOT reflect the actual price.

$0 copay may mean $1000+ charged to your insurance which can lead to higher premiums down the line.

## How It Works

### 1

Your physician will evaluate you in the office.

### 2

Your physician then selects specific oral and topical ingredients needed to improve your condition.

### 3

You will be contacted to provide your billing & shipping information and your medicine is shipped
directly to you!

[[Screenshot_2024-06-06_at_6.50.38_PM.png][Asset-7q2.png]Hyperhidrosis][188] is a serious medical
condition characterized by excessive, uncontrollable sweating and the International Hyperhidrosis
Society is the only global non-profit organization dedicated entirely to improving the lives of
those affected by it.

We are your source for reliable, up-to-date information about
hyperhidrosis [treatments][189] and [research][190]. We're also here to provide you with
understanding and support. If your life is being ruined by sweating - you are NOT alone. Studies
show that hyperhidrosis is common, severe, and emotionally damaging. 

[Research][191] shows that nearly 5% of the world's population suffers from [excessive
sweating][192] or [hyperhidrosis][193]. That's right, 385 MILLION people are struggling with extreme
sweating -- just like you!

Of course, no one's hyperhidrosis is exactly the same. Some people fill their [shoes][194] with
sweat, some have dripping [no-handshakes-please palms][195], some sweat through their [shirts][196],
others sweat through their [jeans][197], and most have a combination of sweaty body areas to contend
with. Regardless of whether you sweat dramatically on your [head][198] or your toes or anywhere in
between, we know the embarrassment, anxiety, and crippling effects are real and we want to help.

As the only independent, global, non-profit advocacy and education organization serving the
hyperhidrosis community, we encourage you to use this website to get smarter about [excessive
sweating][199]. Read, print, [participate][200], download, and [sign-up][201] today.

While you are doing that, we'll be running [medical education courses in hyperhidrosis][202] to help
healthcare providers provide the best hyperhidrosis care possible, supporting new hyperhidrosis
treatment research, talking to journalists around the world to encourage empathy and awareness,
providing you with useful news alerts, and applying for [grants][203] so we can keep going. 

Here are a few of the useful things you'll find on the following pages: comprehensive [treatment
option information][204], U.S. [insurance codes][205], [hyperhidrosis clinical
trials][206] recruiting now, a [Clinician Finder][207], an award-winning [free blog ][208] dedicated
to sweat news, and amazing [product discounts][209] on the most useful sweat-management products.
Your sweat is nearly always with you. We want to be there too.

Feeling the love? Share it! We are stronger when we work together. [Donate][210] today to help us
find a cure and increase public awareness. Yes, tomorrow CAN be better than today.

[[Screenshot_2024-06-06_at_6.50.38_PM.png][Asset-7q2.png]Hyperhidrosis][188] is a serious medical
condition characterized by excessive, uncontrollable sweating and the International Hyperhidrosis
Society is the only global non-profit organization dedicated entirely to improving the lives of
those affected by it.

We are your source for reliable, up-to-date information about
hyperhidrosis [treatments][189] and [research][190]. We're also here to provide you with
understanding and support. If your life is being ruined by sweating - you are NOT alone. Studies
show that hyperhidrosis is common, severe, and emotionally damaging. 

[Research][191] shows that nearly 5% of the world's population suffers from [excessive
sweating][192] or [hyperhidrosis][193]. That's right, 385 MILLION people are struggling with extreme
sweating -- just like you!

Of course, no one's hyperhidrosis is exactly the same. Some people fill their [shoes][194] with
sweat, some have dripping [no-handshakes-please palms][195], some sweat through their [shirts][196],
others sweat through their [jeans][197], and most have a combination of sweaty body areas to contend
with. Regardless of whether you sweat dramatically on your [head][198] or your toes or anywhere in
between, we know the embarrassment, anxiety, and crippling effects are real and we want to help.

As the only independent, global, non-profit advocacy and education organization serving the
hyperhidrosis community, we encourage you to use this website to get smarter about [excessive
sweating][199]. Read, print, [participate][200], download, and [sign-up][201] today.

While you are doing that, we'll be running [medical education courses in hyperhidrosis][202] to help
healthcare providers provide the best hyperhidrosis care possible, supporting new hyperhidrosis
treatment research, talking to journalists around the world to encourage empathy and awareness,
providing you with useful news alerts, and applying for [grants][203] so we can keep going. 

Here are a few of the useful things you'll find on the following pages: comprehensive [treatment
option information][204], U.S. [insurance codes][205], [hyperhidrosis clinical
trials][206] recruiting now, a [Clinician Finder][207], an award-winning [free blog ][208] dedicated
to sweat news, and amazing [product discounts][209] on the most useful sweat-management products.
Your sweat is nearly always with you. We want to be there too.

Feeling the love? Share it! We are stronger when we work together. [Donate][210] today to help us
find a cure and increase public awareness. Yes, tomorrow CAN be better than today.
